reference_state: e03 ended INCONCLUSIVE with native configure=-6, zero model/GPU work, and no normal numerical DLL initialization

counting_contract.kernel_unit: A device kernel grid invocation; grid blocks/threads are not separate kernels
counting_contract.conservative_charge: Reserve/charge before a potentially submitted kernel invocation; retain failed/aborted attempt charges without refund so admitted physical invocations cannot exceed charged bounds
not_equivalent_to_kernel_count: number of graph replay API calls
counting_contract.unknown: Unknown physical activity is not zero. Reject the unproved route or retain a source/binary-bound conservative upper bound with a trusted enforcement proof.

lifecycle.before: Any normal numerical DLL load or device work
lifecycle.required: Fresh original-thread/host lease clearance; immutable code/model/runtime/device/graph identities; one canonical same-family durable reservation and global deadline
lifecycle.zero_GPU_claim: Only if this phase performs CPU/PE/file inspection without target DLL initialization

lifecycle.phase: Numerical DLL dependency loading and initialization
lifecycle.required: An authority/enforcement boundary exists before these actions, or a pinned initialization path is proved to emit zero kernels. An exported budget function inside the DLL cannot alone guard code that runs before that function can be called.
lifecycle.e03_limit: PE parsing/export presence is not normal-load or initialization evidence

lifecycle.required: Pin actual runtime/driver path and account for every possible kernel-producing action; distinguish queries/allocations/DMA from kernels without assuming internal activity is zero
All kernel-producing loading work belongs to the same original quota. No unmetered model-load or setup exception may be introduced because the service endpoint begins later.
Bound actual dispatch paths and physical groups, rows and all emitted kernels. A model request counter alone does not cover setup or warmup.

One admitted profile covers both target and draft throughout the actual k3 bonus → seed → L4 rejection → correction → continuation chain, preserving requested outputs/state. No source-local counter may reset per cycle or arm.
These are charged work even when excluded from latency estimates. Capture bytes and API/DMA work remain separate dimensions; any capture-associated kernel work is included in the kernel quota.

Close the final possible kernel-producing interval before accepting final usage. Process death leaves unknown actuals charged to durable reservation; it is not a refund or evidence of zero teardown work.

launch_routes.obligation: A pre-submission guard covers the actual compiled call path, including helper macros and generated templates, not only a source inventory

Charge a trusted frozen bound on all kernel-node invocations reachable in each replay, including child/conditional/loop/update behavior, or reject graph capture/replay. One replay call is not one kernel.

Prove/guard internal physical submissions or a conservative per-call bound for the exact binary/algorithm/input/workspace path; otherwise reject before invoking the library. A host library call is not automatically one kernel.
Do not convert every API/DMA operation into one kernel. Prove the pinned path's kernel activity or leave the physical bound unqualified; blanket denials can make the complete model profile unusable.

All linked TUs and submitting threads in one admitted worker share one atomic allowance. Duplicate DLL copies, reentrant configuration, alternate loaders and new processes cannot manufacture fresh limits. The canonical family ledger bounds the aggregate of worker reservations.

trust_and_release.proof_registry: Native proof IDs and their scope must be owned/frozen by the implementation or independent authority. Caller-created JSON booleans, caller-supplied matching hashes or metadata claims cannot become native authority.
trust_and_release.empty_registry: An empty compiled-native proof registry necessarily returns BLOCKED/NOT_RUN, even when arithmetic and schema validation of a synthetic plan passes.
trust_and_release.CPU_mock: Atomic counter and lifecycle planner tests establish CPU behavior only. They do not prove driver/runtime coverage, numerical DLL initialization, actual C dispatch or complete native request usability.
trust_and_release.narrow_profile: Must prove both closure (no unknown routes) and usability (every required lifecycle action has a qualified admitted route). Rejecting all opaque work is fail-closed but does not establish a runnable model executor.
trust_and_release.graph_fairness: The same admitted graph policy must apply to A/B/C and relevant reference/draft controls; disabling graphs selectively is a changed comparison contract.
trust_and_release.cost_readiness: Kernel guards and synchronization have real costs. Complete same-request service costs remain required after numerical qualification; no mock or source bound supplies a latency result.

currently_unclaimable: The original 4096 full physical-kernel quota has been qualified merely because all visible CUDA sites are wrapped
One API/library/graph call equals one physical kernel
The numerical DLL was safely initialized because its PE exports exist
A complete target/draft model request is runnable because unknown routes are denied
A caller-authored native proof manifest establishes independent release authority
CPU fixtures or a linked DLL qualify actual quantized activations, full outputs, state or the real consumer chain
A/B/C system benefit, memory traffic reduction, occupancy or service improvement exists without admitted native evidence
Second-round admission follows from source, mock, planner or offline PE success
